notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS ITSM vendor evaluating Redwood for internal IT/helpdesk chatbot (internal only). Primary driver = faster, predictable responses for internal agents + auditability.

POC ask: start on Hosted API (quick win) to validate streaming + function/tool calling latency and correctness. If results OK, move to Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable p95 under load and to satisfy SLA for internal SLAs.

Latency / perf: target p95 end-to-end for short ticket lookups <400ms; for longer context flows streaming preferred (user-visible token stream). Customer emphasized 'must feel instant to agents' and 'no timeouts when calling internal tools'.

Security: SSO/SAML mandatory for console access; audit logs and retention controls required (logs to be retained 12 months for compliance, exportable); KMS integration required for dedicated. Infosec wants encryption-at-rest details and SOC2 attestation.

Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget but willing to commit to reserved capacity if we can show unit economics + clear break-even vs hosted. Procurement asked for a 12-month TCO comparison (hosted vs dedicated).

POC scope (requested):
- 30-day POC on hosted API with a latency harness (simulate 50 concurrent agents)
- 3 sample tool-call integrations (ticket lookup, runbook search, escalation action)
- streaming enabled, function-calling exercised, and sample fallback behavior documented
- telemetry: per-token cost, p50/p95/p99 latency, error rates, audit log export sample

Quotes from calls: "If this feels fast, we can roll to 1k agents quickly"; "Our SOC team needs that KMS/HSM answer before contracts".

Open items: need final POC SOW, signed NDA for deeper security docs, clear pricing for burst capacity and for migrating to Dedicated.

Attachments: see Drive links; Fireflies for demo transcripts (IDs above).
